mu_name_from: MODEL_DEADLY_STAFF (MODEL_STAFF + 30), loaded from Item/Staff_31.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1113). Ours is named Staff31 by the index-plus-one rule. Group 5 number 30 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:266.
